title: Sharp Truncated Difference Estimates for Nonlocal Nonconvex Functionals Defined by Superlevel Sets
summary: Let $N\in\mathbb N$ and $p\in[1,\infty)$. In this article, we consider a family $\{Φ_{λ,p}^γ\}_{λ\in(0,\infty)}$ of nonlocal nonconvex functionals with a real parameter $γ$ and establish two truncated difference estimates bounded by these functionals with the sharp range of $γ$; that is, for any $γ\in(-\infty,-1]$, any $λ\in(0,\infty)$, any cube $Q\subset\mathbb R^N$, and any measurable function $g:Q\to\mathbb R$, \begin{align*} &\int_Q\int_Q\left[\frac{|g(x)-g(y)|-λ|x-y|^{1+γ/p}}{\ell(Q)^{1+γ/p}}\right]_+^p\,dx\,dy\\ &\quad\lesssim…
